`class FloatSignal`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Signal<Float>`](/reference/signals/signal/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.impl.primitive` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FloatSignal.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/impl/primitive/FloatSignal.java)

Signal of a `float` with arithmetic that writes its result, for ratios, progress and sizes.

## Description

It works like [`IntegerSignal`](/reference/signals/integersignal/) with `float` values and the Java floating-point rules: dividing by `0F` gives an infinity or `NaN`, without exception.
